CommunityApplications.Profile: 本仓库维护 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）在 Unraid 上的 Community Applications 模板：模板本体、图标与提交说明。容器镜像（多架构 amd64 / arm64，随上游发版自动重建，内置 bubblewrap 以适配没有 Landlock 的 Unraid 内核）由 2220545672/dsh-docker 构建与发布，本模板安装的就是它的 latest 标签；镜像的安装与排障文档在那边，本仓库保留 Unraid 侧说明（那两个 --security-opt 的用途、从其它镜像迁移的步骤）。容器内置 Caddy 反向代理、可选口令门禁与 ALLOWED_CLIENTS 白名单，以 uid 1000 非特权运行。⚠️ 上游处于开发者预览阶段，未来会出现破坏兼容性的变更。 | This repository maintains the Unraid Community Applications template for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): the template itself, its icon and the submission notes. The container image — multi-arch (amd64 / arm64), rebuilt automatically for each upstream release, with bubblewrap bundled for kernels that lack Landlock — is built and published by 2220545672/dsh-docker, and this template installs its latest tag; the image's installation and troubleshooting documentation lives there. Support goes through the Unraid forum thread linked in this profile. The container bundles its reverse proxy, an optional password gate and an ALLOWED_CLIENTS allowlist, and runs unprivileged as uid 1000. ⚠️ Upstream is in developer preview; compatibility-breaking changes are coming. | 支持请走本 profile 中链接的 Unraid 论坛支持帖。
